decisions: CPU micro subitems recorded independently; failed serialization blocks only dependent options
NoCPU2-thread serial screen: no>5% batch1 micro gain
CPU4 threads batch1 micro improved>5%; include full4-episode screen
8/16 actors not run: original logical cohort is4, synchronous training barrier permits at most4 active episodes. More processes only idle; no cohort expansion/training delay allowed.
Object-plane cache not retried: three prior full-loop slowdowns; no new mechanism to overcome key/copy/miss costs.
